cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Hello?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Oh, hello. Is that Julie Davison?

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Yes.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: This is Greg Preston from the Employment Agency. We met last week when you came in to enquire about office work.

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Oh, that’s right.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Now we’ve just had some details come in of a job which might interest you.

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: OK.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: So this is a position for a receptionist – I believe you’ve done that sort of work before? Q1

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Yes, I have, I worked in a sports centre for a couple of years before I got married and had the children.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Right. Well, this job’s in Fordham, so not too far away for you, and it’s at the medical centre there. Q2

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: OK. So where exactly is that?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: It’s quite near the station, on Chastons Road. Q3

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Sorry?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Chastons Road- that’s C-H-A-S-T-O-N-S.

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: OK, thanks. So what would the work involve? Dealing with enquiries from patients?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Yes, and you’d also be involved in making appointments, whether face to face or on the phone. And rescheduling them if necessary. Q4

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Fine, that shouldn’t be a problem.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: And another of your duties would be keeping the centre’s database up-to-date. Then you might have other general administrative duties as well, but those would be the main ones. Q5

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: OK.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Now when the details came in, I immediately thought of you because one thing they do require is someone with experience, and you did mention your work at the sports centre when you came in to see us. Q6

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Yes, in fact I enjoyed that job. Is there anything else they’re looking for?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Well, they say it’s quite a high-pressure environment, they’re always very busy, and patients are often under stress, so they want someone who can cope with that and stay calm, and at the same time be confident when interacting with the public. Q7

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Well, after dealing with three children all under five, I reckon I can cope with that.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: I’m sure you can.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: And then another thing they mention is that they’re looking for someone with good IT skills …

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Not a problem.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: So you’d be interested in following this up?

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Sure. When would it start?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Well, they’re looking for someone from the beginning of next month, but I should tell you that this isn’t a permanent job, it’s temporary, so the contract would be just to the end of September. But they do say that there could be further opportunities after that. Q8

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: OK. And what would the hours be?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Well, they want someone who can start at a quarter to eight in the morning could you manage that?

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Yes, my husband would have to get the kids up and off to my mother’s – she’s going to be looking after them while I’m at work. What time would I finish?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: One fifteen. Q9

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: That should work out all right. I can pick the kids up on my way home, and then I’ll have the afternoon with them. Oh, one thing … is there parking available for staff at the centre? Q10

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Yes, there is. and it’s also on a bus route.

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Right. Well, I expect I’ll have the car but it’s good to know that. OK, so where do I go from here?

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: Well, if you’re happy for me to do so, I’ll forward your CV and references, and then the best thing would probably be for you to phone them so they can arrange for an interview.

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Great. Well thank you very much.

cues.speaker: GREG
cues.text: You’re welcome. Bye now.

cues.speaker: JULIE
cues.text: Bye.
